newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom directed to cut rates from 1998.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom directed to cut rates from 1998.

text.p: German Postal Minister Wolfgang Boetsch has asked Deutsche Telekom AG to cut prices six percent from January 1, 1998, the German magazine Focus reported on Saturday.
Focus said Telekom was also directed to cut prices another six percent two years after that.
A copy of the article was provided to the media in advance of the magazine's publication.
A Telekom spokesman would not confirm details of the story, but said Boetsch had written a letter to Telekom about rates.
